title: Genomics VariantCallingPipeline

stats.done_summary: Completed germline short-variant calling pipeline. Implemented code/run_variant_calling_pipeline.py (bcftools+samtools if available; pysam-based fallback; simulates alignments if manifest CRAMs missing), code/summarize_variants.py (TSV summaries + plots), and code/evaluate_simulated_truth.py (precision/recall vs simulated truth when applicable). Generated per-sample VCFs in outputs/vcfs/, summary tables in outputs/summaries/, metadata in outputs/metadata/, evaluation in outputs/evaluation/, figures in report/images/, and wrote the publication-style report to report/report.md. Also copied report to variant_call_report.md for compatibility with task wording.
